## Description
Briefly describe the change and motivation behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an issue)
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Chore / Governance / Tooling

## Checklist
- [ ] **Atomic Commits**: Commits are focused, granular, and have clear messages.
- [ ] **Git Notes**: Critical design rationale or context attached where appropriate (`git notes add`).
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated `docs/` (architecture, database, UI/UX) if changes impact them.
- [ ] **Code Graph**: Graphify indexed and validated (`graphify update .` or git hook).
- [ ] **Tests & Linting**: Pre-commit checks pass cleanly (`npm run lint` / type checks).
